findings.title: Wire the saved timeout into the shutdown drain
findings.body: POST /settings with shutdown_drain_timeout=120.5 now persists and installs that value, but shutdown still uses _SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_TIMEOUT (triggarr/search/scheduler.py:634,648), initialized exclusively from the environment or 60.0 at lines 58–81. With no environment override, a search needing 90 seconds to drain still times out after 60 seconds despite the accepted 120.5-second setting. This change exposes a writable setting whose runtime consumer ignores it.
findings.recommendation: Resolve the drain timeout from the current application settings at shutdown, applying the documented environment override, and verify that saving 120.5 changes the timeout used by the drain.

next_steps: Connect persistence to the shutdown consumer and test the saved value through shutdown.
